rationale: 437918 showed a positive long-gap recurrence contrast in all four archived births; representative 43 was less extreme than 11. One independent eligible birth is chosen by the displayed rule on discovery worlds only.

holdout_registration.branches: All eight public cue/context combinations from one cloned prefix state per world; learned output weights fixed for every intervention. Score actual held private goal only at readout.
holdout_registration.fixed primary: early outgoing-sender cut compared with eight static sign/weight/excitability and discovery-spike-rate matched controls, one interval per frozen graph. Recurrence perturbation lasts ticks 1..8. Confirm a reproducible privileged sender mechanism only if target cuts shift in the disadvantageous direction beyond matched controls and neither evidence relies on materially larger mean current or activity loss.
holdout_registration.checks: Zero, unconditional mean restoration, two paired mismatched cue waveforms on selected edges, three additional time windows. Cue substitutions preserve the entire per-edge delivered time-series multiset across each same-world block of 8 branches. Motif causal specificity needs agreement across both independent births; actual return sequences and no-intruder 84-tick tails are measured separately.
holdout_registration.unseen_birth_screen: First qualifying birth in registered order, not best. Qualifying uses only discovery worlds: intact endpoint >=50% and difference from full gap recurrence removal >=12 percentage points.
